g.aria-label: Why Splitting d into H Heads of Width d_h = d/H Is Compute-Free
H slices of shape (d × d/H) pack into one (d × d) matrix for Q, K, V, O
H heads × (2 n² d_h + 2 n² d_h)
= 4 n² (H d_h) = 4 n² d (independent of H!)
Only the O(H n²) softmax overhead depends on H · Standard d_h ∈ {64, 128}
